items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 11:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the tenth aspect of the back? The point of the chest of ZA is discerned as the tenth aspect of the back. For the root of the Nukva is from the Malchut of the Nekudim of the smallness, when only six vessels — KHB HGT — came out in ZA up to the chest, and the point of the chest is the Malchut of the Nekudim. However, in relation to the lights, they are discerned as HGT NHY, and the point under the Yesod is the Malchut of the Nekudim. And therefore, also in Atzilut, she has these two roots in ZA: from the aspect of the back of the Nukva, namely the vessels, she is discerned as the point of the chest of ZA; and from the aspect of the face of the Nukva, namely the lights, she is discerned as the point under the Yesod. And the point of the back is called the tenth aspect of the back, and the point of the face is called the tenth aspect of the face. (Item 144).
